ghosts.name: Mumble
ghosts.line: Oh! A visitor! I have been reading the same page for a hundred years. I forgot how the story ends.

ghosts.name: Dusty
ghosts.line: Achoo! Sorry. I only wanted someone to sneeze near. It gets quiet in here.

ghosts.name: Wisp
ghosts.line: Were you looking for me? Nobody has looked for me in ages!

ghosts.name: Flicker
ghosts.line: I keep the attic stars polished. Would you like to see my favourite one?

ghosts.name: Hum
ghosts.line: Hmm hm hmm... oh! I was humming to myself. I do that when I am lonely.

ghosts.name: Nook
ghosts.line: This is my best hiding corner. You found it! You must be very clever.
